did: Built Snips Capture, a workflow the owner dispatches by hand. It photographs every screen of the app on sample data and hands home one checked bundle. The web app is taken at desktop and phone sizes. The Android app runs on an emulator paired with a stand-in home: the release build is reached by its own taps, and the debug build covers only the screens taps cannot reach. The run on main is green end to end, with 101 snips in a bundle whose checksums hold. Along the way I found and fixed the Pages site keeping a viewer's data across reloads, and fixed my own regression in the bundle job.

calls.title: How a snip is named
options: surface, address, size, app version and a short content hash
a number counted within each run
calls.why: Essays will name snips by hand, so a name has to be readable and stay the same across runs; a screen that changes gets a new name.
calls.undo: Change snipId and the name rules in docs/snips.md; home refiles its snips under the new names.

calls.title: How long the bundle is kept on GitHub
options: keep the newest one for a day
delete it as soon as its run ends
calls.why: Home picks the bundle up after the run, and the hourly sweep would delete a bundle consumed in its run before home got to it.
calls.undo: Set the snips-bundle family to keep 0 and drop Snips Capture from retention.yml.

calls.title: What one snip shows
options: the screen as it settles, plus a short recording where it still moves
calls.why: The pictures are for essays and a showcase, where a screen-sized image reads like the phone.
calls.undo: Take full pages in the web walk, or record every screen.

calls.title: Which Android build the pictures come from
options: the release build wherever its own taps reach a screen, the debug build elsewhere
the debug build for every screen
calls.why: The owner wants the real application. Only the debug build can be sent to any address, so it covers just the screens taps cannot reach.
calls.undo: Drop the release pass from capture-apk.sh, so every picture comes from the debug build.

left: SNIPS2, home's pickup of the bundle, is not built: it waits on a server session, which the owner said not to start tonight. docs/snips.md has its contract.
The release walk misses Studio's two-tab bar, so Game day exists only as a debug picture; #3137 holds the options for the owner.
Studio's renders card says pair this phone on a paired phone after a page load; filed as #3128 under SIGNIN for the sign-in work.
The Android pictures show what a fresh install paired with the stand-in shows, mostly empty screens; richer sample data for the stand-in is a follow-up.
The old branch claude/snips-capture is stale, with no pull request; my force-push to it was refused, so it can be deleted.
